# Build Basilan

## About

Build Basilan is a community technology initiative founded by Jaymar Maruji in Basilan, Philippines.

The initiative helps NGOs, youth organizations, and community groups improve their digital presence.

## Services

- Website development
- NGO websites
- Community organization websites
- Digital accessibility
- Website maintenance

## Founder

Jaymar Maruji
Founder and Solo Developer

## Location

Basilan, Philippines
